prompts: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: production logo symbol and desktop app icon for Lenscribe, a quiet background app that reads text from saved images and makes those images searchable. Design one original, polished, compact emblem: a bold rounded image frame with a small circular sun and a simple mountain silhouette that transitions into three horizontal text strokes. Unify the image and text elements into one distinctive balanced mark with an implied L silhouette, rather than a collection of separate icons. Flat vector-style geometry, clean precise edges, generous negative space, thick shapes that remain legible at 24–32 pixels. Palette: deep forest green #2F725C and soft sage green #A4BE84, harmonizing with a calm pale-green desktop settings UI. One centered mark, tightly framed with about 10% clear margin, square canvas, genuinely transparent background outside and within negative spaces. No wordmark, no letters, no extra text, no surrounding badge or rounded-square tile, no AI sparkle, no magnifying glass, no gradients, no shadows, no textures, no mockups, no multiple concepts or presentation board. Render a finished logo asset.

Use case: logo-brand. Edit target: the attached Lenscribe logo. Preserve the existing rounded image-frame, sun, mountain and three text-bar composition and silhouette. Make one targeted production cleanup: replace all shading and gradients with uniform fully opaque solid flat fills, deep green #2F725C for the frame/mountains and sage #A4BE84 for the sun/text bars. Remove every yellow fringe, stray pixel, glow and speck around the perimeter and between the text bars. Precise smooth vector-like anti-aliased edges. The logo shapes must be fully opaque; only the background and intended negative space must be genuinely transparent. Keep the icon centered on a square canvas, retaining around 10% transparent margin. No text, no tile, no new elements. Deliver one clean finished transparent logo asset, not a presentation.
